author: TheHobbitsEnd
body:
Hi my name is Aaron also known as hobbit I am here to apply for Referee!.

My IGN is TheHobbitsEnd!

Discord is Endofhobbits0727#1861 I will always be active.

Mostly available Saturday-Wednesday but I'm not available Thursday-Friday but I have tournaments so I might not be available on Monday or Tuesday!.

I would love to be a Referee to help avicus with a lot of things such as banning hackers and making sure people don't spam I know that's suppose to be a moderators job but if a moderator isn't here I will do my best to stop people from spamming or hacking I'll be a good referee!.

My name is Aaron I live in Rockford but I am moving to another state in 2-3 weeks from now, I probably won't be on for about a week or so that won't be so bad, I am 14 years old my birthday is in June 13, my height is  5'5 I have 5 siblings I am the second oldest.i love to play games , i am nice kind you name it but my worst fear is heights one time I went to 6 flags I rode one ride which was the supermen and I never went on any ride except for the baby rides now you know I'm terrified of heights.thats all I hope you accept my application welp Peace!!!
